sentences.en: She chose to become an internist after medical school.
sentences.zh: 她医学院毕业后选择了成为一名内科医师。

sentences.en: The patient was referred to the internist for heart problems.
sentences.zh: 这名患者因为心脏问题被转诊给内科医师。

sentences.en: An internist specializes in diagnosing illnesses affecting internal organs.
sentences.zh: 内科医师专门诊治影响内脏器官的疾病。
